scientific_integrity: Primary geometric combinatorics is credited to earlier work. The new proof consists of an explicit Frobenius fixed-subset formula, complete 22-class exact comparison, and bounded finite-field realization. Finite computational enumeration establishes a finite classification only. No independent audit or external formal certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the Frobenius-stable eight-point blow-up subclass; character at least 5; general-position input; \mathfrak{S}_8 action, not every \mathrm{W}(E_8) form. The result recovers the eight-point Frobenius partition and theta-tritangent finite-scheme zeta function, not the Jacobian Weil polynomial or the curve. The q>1456 geometric-realizability threshold is sufficient and not optimal.
title: Three tritangent counts reconstruct eight-point Frobenius splitting on degree-one del Pezzo surfaces
